sources.title: PoolFormer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The PoolFormer model was proposed in MetaFormer is Actually What You Need for Vision by Sea AI Labs. Instead of designing complicated token mixer to achieve SOTA performance, the target of this work is to demonstrate the competence of transformer models largely stem from the general architecture MetaFormer.

sources.title: PoolFormer — Docs | Model Database
sources.snippet: PoolFormer: reference documentation for working with open source AI models and libraries. Compare and deploy AI models on Model Database.
